mapper.sql: r.return_id, r.return_no, r.status, r.cust_id, r.plant_cd, r.lot_id, r.lot_no, r.item_id, r.unit_cd, r.qty, r.replace_yn, r.po_line_id, r.ship_ref, i.unit_cd as base_unit, i.lot_ctrl_yn, case when r.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 else uc.factor end as factor, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = i.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = i.unit_cd)) as base_scale, pl.unit_cd as po_unit, case when pl.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 else ucp.factor end as po_factor, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = pl.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = pl.unit_cd)) as po_scale

from srm_return r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join mst_unit_conv uc on uc.item_id = r.item_id and uc.from_unit = r.unit_cd and uc.to_unit = i.unit_cd and uc.use_yn = 'Y' left join srm_po_line pl on pl.po_line_id = r.po_line_id left join mst_unit_conv ucp on ucp.item_id = r.item_id and ucp.from_unit = pl.unit_cd and ucp.to_unit = i.unit_cd and ucp.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: select where r.return_no = #{returnNo} and r.status in ('CONFIRMED', 'SHIPPED')
select exists (select 1 from srm_return where ship_ref = #{trxRef})
select trx_ref from srm_po_receipt where po_line_id = #{poLineId} and lot_id = #{lotId} and qty > 0 order by receipt_id limit 1
select coalesce(sum(qty), 0) from srm_po_receipt where po_line_id = #{poLineId} and lot_id = #{lotId}
select p.po_no from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id where l.po_line_id = #{poLineId}
